groups.title: words 讠
groups.note: Speech on the left: asking, teaching, wording.

chars.story: Words carried off in every direction 方, asking after people: visit.
Words flowing steadily like a river 川: teach, train.
Words 讠 a clerk 司 sorts and records: a word, a term.
chars.note: 字 is one character; 词 is a word, often two characters.

chars.story: Words 讠 that bear fruit 果: a lesson.

chars.parts: 讠 words + 吴 a man with head thrown back
chars.story: Words 讠 shouted by a man swaying with his head thrown back 吴: an error.
chars.note: Also 'miss, delay' (耽误).

groups.title: walk 辶
groups.note: The walking road along the bottom.

chars.parts: 辶 walk + 禺 a monkey (sound)
chars.story: Walking 辶 along and running into a monkey 禺: encounter.
Walking 辶 backwards, stubbornly 艮 facing the enemy: retreat.
chars.note: Also 'return' a thing (退货).

chars.story: Walking 辶 hard after the troops 𠂤: chase.
Walking 辶 away from something precious 贵: leave it behind.
Walking 辶 into a crowd 曹 of troubles: suffer.
chars.note: Always something bad: 遭到批评 'come in for criticism'.

groups.title: trouble
groups.note: Danger, poison, violence, chaos, death, evil.

chars.parts: ⺈ person + 厂 cliff + 㔾 crouching man
chars.story: A person ⺈ on a cliff top 厂, another crouched 㔾 beneath it: danger.

chars.parts: 龶 plant + 毋 do not
chars.story: A plant 龶 over 毋 'do not!': poison.
chars.note: Also 'cruel, fierce'.

chars.parts: 日 sun + 共 hands together + 氺 water
chars.story: Fierce sun 日, hands 共 spreading the grain, then a sudden downpour 氺: violent.
chars.note: Also 'expose' (暴露).

chars.story: A tongue 舌 caught on a hook 乚: words in a tangle: disorder.
chars.note: As an adverb 'at random': 乱说. 亂: the left became 舌.

chars.parts: - a man 亠 ducking behind a wall 𠃊
chars.story: A man ducking behind a wall and out of sight: gone.
chars.note: His Analects card: 'lost'. Modern 亡 is mostly 'die' (死亡) and 'flee' (逃亡).

chars.story: A heart 心 crushed down under 亚: evil.
chars.note: 惡: 亞 on top became 亚. His Analects card: 'hate / bad'; modern 恶 is 'evil, vicious'.

groups.title: water 氵 and ice 冫
groups.note: Three drops: water. Two drops: ice.

chars.parts: 氵 water + 日 sun + 皿 dish
chars.story: Water 氵 in a dish 皿 left in the sun 日: lukewarm.
chars.note: 溫: the right side's 囚 became 日. His Analects 'review' survives in 温习 'revise'.

chars.story: Where the water 氵 runs little 少: sand.
chars.note: 沙发 'sofa' is a loanword.

chars.story: Water 氵 lying wide and still: a lake.
chars.note: 湖南 and 湖北 are the provinces south and north of Lake Dongting.

chars.story: Ice 冫 melting away, all 咸 of it: reduce.
chars.note: Two drops 冫, not three: 減 had 氵.

chars.story: Water rushing 冫 through the middle 中: dash, charge.
chars.note: 衝 'charge' and 沖 'rinse' merged into 冲.

chars.story: An axe 斤 splitting wood 木 apart: analyze.
chars.note: Almost always in 分析.

chars.story: Wood 木 with the talent 才 to become something: timber, material.

chars.parts: 木 tree + 反 turn over
chars.story: Wood 木 sawn flat and turned over 反: a board.
chars.note: 老板 'boss' (old 闆).

chars.story: A wooden 木 shaft from the armoury 仓: spear, now gun.

groups.title: tree 木 inside
groups.note: The tree is underneath, or boxed in.

chars.story: A sweet 甘 fruit on a certain tree 木: some, a certain one.
Nine 九 kinds of wood 木 in one pile: mixed.
chars.note: 雜: 衣 and 隹 became 九 over 木.

chars.parts: 木 tree + 口 a cord
chars.story: A cord 口 tied round a bundle of sticks 木: bundle, bind.
chars.note: 结束 'finish' is its commonest word.

chars.story: A tree 木 boxed in 囗, with no room to grow: trapped.
chars.note: Also 'sleepy' (old 睏): 我困了 'I'm sleepy'.

chars.story: Wooden 木 beams stacked storey on storey: a building.
chars.note: Also 'floor': 三楼 'third floor'. 樓: 婁 became 娄.

chars.story: Under the shelter 广, two people sitting 坐 on the ground: a seat.
chars.note: A measure for mountains, buildings, cities: 一座山.

chars.story: Steps cut into a hillside 阝, one between 介 the next: stairs.
chars.note: Mostly 'stage, rank': 阶段 'phase', 阶级 'class'.

chars.story: A cliff overhang 厂, now a roof over a workshop: factory.
chars.note: His Analects card: 'cliff', the component. Alone, 厂 is 'factory' (old 廠).

chars.parts: - an altar stand, bound at the waist
chars.story: A tall altar stand, tied with cloth, raised to heaven: the supreme ruler.
chars.note: 上帝 is the Christian God.

chars.story: A hand 又 laid on the earth 土 in blessing: holy.
chars.note: 聖 had 耳 ear and 口 mouth over 王; now 又 over 土.

chars.parts: 曲 bundle of slips + 八 stand
chars.story: A bundle of writing slips 曲 set on a stand 八: a classic work.
chars.note: Also 'ceremony' (典礼) and 'model' (典型 'typical').

chars.story: An oath sworn over a dish 皿 of blood, before sun and moon 明: a league.

chars.parts: 圭 earth on earth + 寸 hand
chars.story: A hand 寸 piling earth 土 土 into a boundary mound: grant land, close it in: seal.
chars.note: A measure for letters: 一封信 'one letter'.

chars.parts: - 巾 cloth with a stroke on top
chars.story: A piece of cloth 巾, once used as money: currency.
chars.note: 幣: 敝 over 巾 shrank to one stroke.

chars.story: A cauldron 鬲 with steam curling up like a worm 虫: things melt and blend.
chars.note: 金融 'finance' is its commonest word.

chars.story: A bird 隹 held up, a mouth 口 calling the price: sell, retail.
A slice 片 of wood hung low 卑 over the shop door: signboard.
chars.note: Also 'brand' (品牌) and playing cards (打牌).

chars.story: A boat 舟 riding high 亢 on the waves: navigate.
chars.note: Also of planes: 航空 'aviation', 航班 'flight'.

chars.parts: 癶 two feet + 豆 raised stand
chars.story: Two feet 癶 stepping up onto a raised stand 豆: mount, climb.
chars.note: Also 'publish, record' (刊登, 登记 'register').

chars.story: Steps 彳 marching straight 正 at the enemy: an expedition.
chars.note: 徵 'sign, levy' merged into it: 特征 'feature', 征收 'levy'.

chars.parts: 告 tell + 非 two backs
chars.story: Two sides 非 pressed back to back, one leaning on the other: lean on.
chars.note: Also 'rely on' and 'be near'.

groups.title: head 页
groups.note: 页 on the right is a head.

chars.story: A head 页 with its face up: the top of a sheet: page.
chars.note: As a right side 页 still means 'head': 顾, 额, 频.

chars.story: The sum written on the board above the guest's 客 head 页: a fixed amount.
chars.note: Its first sense is 'forehead' (额头).

chars.story: A head 页 turned back over the shoulder to check: look after.
chars.note: Also 'look back' (回顾).

groups.title: bamboo ⺮
groups.note: Bamboo on top: slips for writing, sticks.

chars.story: A bamboo ⺮ slip that fits 合 the question: answer.

chars.parts: ⺮ bamboo + 巩 firm (工 work + 凡)
chars.story: Bamboo ⺮ poles and the work 工 of tamping earth: put up.
chars.note: 築: the 木 at the bottom dropped off.

chars.story: Everyone 佥 marks the bamboo ⺮ slip: sign.
A woman 女 who brings a certain 某 man and woman together: go-between, media.
chars.note: The old sense is 'matchmaker'.

chars.story: A woman 女 one step up 且 from you: elder sister.

chars.parts: 女 woman + 彐 hand with a broom
chars.story: A woman 女 with a broom 彐 in hand: the wife of the house.
chars.note: 婦: 帚 broom shrank to 彐.

chars.story: A sickness 疒 that is done with 了: cured.

chars.parts: 广 lean-to + 彐 hand + 氺 grain dots
chars.story: Under a roof 广, a hand 彐 threshing grain that spills 氺: well fed and healthy.
A person 亻 who builds 建 up his body: strengthen.
chars.note: 健身房 'gym'.

chars.story: Grain 禾 that must 必 be hidden away: secret.
Grain 禾 kept for oneself 厶: private.
Hidden away under the grass 艹: hide, store.
chars.note: Also 'store, collect', and 'Tibet' in 西藏.

chars.story: A hand 扌 giving so the other hand can receive 受: confer, teach.
chars.note: 教授 'professor'.

chars.parts: 比 side by side + 十 ten
chars.story: Two figures 比 side by side over a crossed 十: all done: finished.
chars.note: 毕竟 'after all'.

chars.story: A body 尸 arriving from 由 its journey on the due date: a session.
chars.note: A measure for recurring events: 第十届 'the tenth'; 应届 'this year's graduates'.

chars.story: An arrow 矢 no longer than a small vessel 豆: short.
A pot 缶 with a piece broken 夬 out: lacking.
Walking each 各 field 田 quickly, just roughly: brief, slightly.
chars.note: Also 'outline, plan': 战略 'strategy'.

chars.parts: 巳 coiled shape + 廾 two hands
chars.story: Two hands 廾 holding up a strange mask 巳: different.
chars.note: 異: 田 over 共 became 巳 over 廾.

chars.parts: 匕 person + 矢 arrow + マ + 疋 foot
chars.story: A man at a fork, arrow 矢 in hand, feet 疋 not moving: doubt.

chars.parts: 冂 inner room + 米 rice + 大 big
chars.story: Rice 米 stored deep in the inner room 冂: hidden, obscure.
chars.note: 奥运 is the Olympics; 奥地利 Austria.

chars.parts: 艹 (once two fires) + 冖 cover + 力 strength
chars.story: Strength 力 spent under a cover 冖, fires burning late above: toil.
chars.note: 勞: the two fires 火火 on top became 艹.

chars.parts: 扌 hand + 喿 birds on a tree
chars.story: A hand 扌 on a tree full of chirping mouths 喿: steer them, operate.
chars.note: 操作 'operate' is its commonest word. Online it is also a swear word.

chars.story: An uncle's 叔 eye 目 on you: the supervisor.
A knife 刂 cutting notches on a timer: a quarter hour, a moment.
chars.note: Also 'carve' (雕刻) and 'a quarter hour' (一刻).

chars.story: A river with its branching streams, flowing on and on: forever.

chars.parts: - a tuft of hair or a feather
chars.story: A feather or tuft with fine strands: hair.
chars.note: Also the 10-cent unit (一毛), and the surname Mao.

chars.parts: - 二 above a curl 厶
chars.story: Layers 二 with a curl 厶 of vapour under them: cloud.
chars.note: 雲 had 雨 rain on top. In classical texts 云 is 'say' (子云).

chars.story: The hand 𠂇 that holds the tool 工 steady: the left.
chars.note: 左右 after a number means 'about'.

chars.story: Flesh 月 still alive 生 after the fight: victory.
chars.note: 勝: 朕 and 力 became 月 and 生.

chars.story: A shell 贝 tapped 攵 to pieces: ruined, defeated.

chars.parts: 车 cart + 俞 dugout canoe (sound)
chars.story: A cart 车 hauling a dugout 俞 overland: convey.
chars.note: Also 'lose' a game (输了 'lost'); 运输 is 'transport'.

chars.story: A cart 车 riding so smooth you yawn 欠: soft.

groups.title: silk 纟 糸
groups.note: Silk on the left 纟, or underneath 糸.

chars.story: Silk 纟 boiled and beaten over and over until soft: practice.

chars.parts: 十 top + 冖 cover + 糸 silk
chars.story: Strands 糸 twisted into a rope, followed hand over hand: search.
chars.note: The old sense is 'rope'.

chars.parts: 口 mouth + 未 not yet
chars.story: A mouth 口 on food not yet 未 swallowed: flavor.
chars.note: 意味着 'means, signifies'. Also 'smell' (气味).

chars.story: A mouth 口 reaching 及 for air: breathe in, inhale.
A hand 寸 held out to a person 亻: pay.
A person 亻 who arrives 到 face-down: fallen over.
chars.note: Also 'pour' and 'upside down'; 倒是 'actually'.

groups.title: bow 弓
groups.note: A bow, or a cord wound like one.

chars.story: A single 单 pellet shot from a bow 弓: bullet.
chars.note: Also 'pluck, bounce': 弹琴 'play the piano', 弹性 'elastic'.

chars.parts: - a cord wound down a stake
chars.story: A cord wound down a stake, the lower turns after the upper: younger brother.
Stone 石 weights at the horse 马 trader's scale, each numbered: numbers, code.
chars.note: Also 'wharf' (码头) and 起码 'at least'.

chars.story: The stone 石 that sticks out 出 under a pillar: foundation.
chars.note: Only in 基础.

groups.title: altar 礻 and clothes 衤
groups.note: Lookalikes: 礻 altar has one dot, 衤 clothes two.

chars.parts: 礻 altar + 乚 bowing figure
chars.story: An altar 礻 with a figure bowing 乚 before it: rite.
chars.note: 禮: 豊 on the right became 乚. His Analects card: 'ritual'; modern also 'gift' and 'manners'.

chars.story: Clothes 衤 with a crack 卜 in them: patch, mend.

groups.title: evening 夕
groups.note: 夕 is a crescent moon: evening.

chars.parts: 亠 lid + 亻 person + 夕 evening
chars.story: A person 亻 under a roof 亠, the evening moon 夕 outside: night.
Woods 林 at dusk 夕, shapes looming: a dream.
chars.note: 夢: the top became 林.

chars.parts: - a line cut through and bent
chars.story: A line cut through and bent at the foot: seven.
An arm bent round, almost back to ten: nine.

groups.title: tooth 牙
groups.note: A tooth, and a tooth boring through.

chars.story: A molar with its roots spread: tooth.
chars.note: 西班牙 is Spain; 葡萄牙 Portugal.

chars.story: A tooth 牙 boring a hole 穴 right through, as an arm goes through a sleeve: wear.
chars.note: Also 'pierce, go through' (穿过).

sentences.en: The ceremony will take place tomorrow.
She and I are brother and sister.
I want to climb this mountain.
His audience is falling off these days.

sentences.zh: 她被视为日本的毕加索。
sentences.en: She is known as the Japanese Picasso.

sentences.zh: 他在枪每时每刻有子弹。
你必须从失败中吸取教训。
我们九点上课，可是他九点一刻才来。
sentences.en: We start class at nine o'clock, but he didn’t come until quarter past.

sentences.zh: 我的刻录软件显示了一个错误信息。
sentences.en: My data-burning software is showing an error message.
